details.question: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.rewritten: PayNow 转账要收钱吗？
details.hyde: 一般免费。通过 PayNow 转账至本地账户通常不收手续费；海外电汇、FAST/GIRO、多币种账户等按收费表执行，以交易页面显示为准。

details.question: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.rewritten: What's the charge for sending a TT to Malaysia?
details.hyde: TT charges to Malaysia vary by currency and channel. An overseas telegraphic transfer fee, cable charge and correspondent bank charges may apply. Please check the latest fee schedule in Internet Banking or at a branch for the exact amount.

details.question: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.rewritten: 你们的 exchange rate 是怎么定的？周末会不会不一样？
details.hyde: 汇率按本行实时牌价并参考国际市场制定，含点差；周末及公共假期市场休市，汇率可能不同。海外电汇、PayNow/FAST/GIRO及多币种账户兑换以交易时牌价为准。

details.question: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
expected: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
details.rewritten: I paid in USD on Amazon with my Visa, why was there an extra 3.25%?
details.hyde: This 3.25% is a Visa foreign transaction/cross-border fee charged when a purchase is processed in a currency other than your card’s currency or by an overseas merchant. It is shown separately on your statement.
kept: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.rewritten: 在日本 ATM 拿钱要多少 fee？
details.hyde: 日本ATM取款会收取海外ATM取款手续费，可能另加当地ATM服务费；费率按账户类型、金额及汇率计，多币种账户可直接扣外币，交易需PIN。最新费率请查官网。
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.rewritten: statement 上面有一笔看不懂的小额 charge 是什么？
details.hyde: 该小额 charge 可能为海外电汇/跨境交易费、多币种账户外币兑换费、PayNow/FAST/GIRO 手续费，或预授权/OTP 验证扣款。请登录网银查看交易详情，或联系客服核实。

details.question: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
expected: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
details.rewritten: 信用卡年费可以免吗？
details.hyde: 可以。部分信用卡首年免年费，后续可通过达标消费、积分兑换或致电客服申请豁免，最终以本行审批及信用卡条款为准。
kept: 银行卡年费与其他卡费
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.rewritten: What's the difference between PayNow and FAST?
details.hyde: PayNow lets you send SGD instantly using a mobile number/UEN; FAST is the interbank instant transfer system for account-number transfers. PayNow uses FAST.

details.question: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.rewritten: FAST transfer 一般几分钟会到？
details.hyde: FAST 转账一般即时到账，通常几分钟内；如遇收款行系统维护或风控审核，可能延迟，请以交易状态为准。

details.question: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.rewritten: How do I send money to my mum's bank account in China?
details.hyde: Use our Overseas Telegraphic Transfer (TT) from your multi-currency account to your mum’s bank account in China. Provide her bank name, account number, SWIFT/BIC and recipient details; confirm with OTP. Charges apply.

details.question: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.rewritten: 我朋友在美国要汇钱给我，要给他什么资料？
details.hyde: 请提供收款户名、多币种账户号码、开户银行名称及地址、SWIFT/BIC代码；如汇美元，请确认账户可收美元。海外电汇到账可能需您配合OTP/身份核验。

details.question: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.rewritten: Why can't I add Binance as a payee?
details.hyde: Binance isn’t supported as a PayNow/FAST/GIRO payee. For overseas wire transfers, it must pass compliance screening and may be blocked by our risk policy. Please use a permitted multi-currency account or another licensed platform.

details.question: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.rewritten: 我想一次转 SGD 10,000 给朋友，可以吗？
details.hyde: 可以。PayNow/FAST 在单笔及每日限额内可转 SGD 10,000，需 PIN/OTP 验证；若超限，可调整限额或改用多币种账户/海外电汇，具体以账户设置为准。

details.question: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.rewritten: My transfer got returned, what usually causes that?
details.hyde: Common causes: incorrect/incomplete beneficiary details (name, account no., SWIFT/IBAN, branch code), closed/restricted account, unsupported currency/route for overseas wire transfer, PayNow/FAST/GIRO identifier mismatch, or compliance/limit checks. Verify details and retry.

details.question: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.rewritten: 新卡收到了要怎么开通？
details.hyde: 请通过手机银行/网上银行选择“卡片激活”，按提示输入卡号并完成OTP验证，设置PIN即可开通。开通后可绑定PayNow，用于FAST/GIRO及多币种账户消费和海外电汇。

details.question: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.rewritten: My new card still hasn't arrived after two weeks
details.hyde: Please check your card application status and mailing address in our app. If dispatched over 7 working days ago, call our hotline to report non-receipt and request a replacement; we may block the current card. Activate with OTP/PIN once received.

details.question: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: 我的 PIN 输错三次了，现在用不了
details.hyde: 您的PIN因连续输错三次已被锁定。请通过网上银行/手机银行使用OTP验证后重置PIN，或携带有效证件前往任一网点办理解锁。重置后即可正常使用。
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.rewritten: Why does my card keep getting declined overseas?
details.hyde: Overseas use may be disabled, or limits, multi-currency account balance, PIN/OTP checks may apply. Enable overseas card use and check limits/balance in the app, or contact us.

details.question: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.rewritten: ATM 把我的卡吃掉了
details.hyde: 如ATM吞卡，请立即联系本行客服并提供卡号、ATM位置及时间；切勿向他人透露PIN或OTP。可携身份证件到附近网点取回或办理补卡。

details.question: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.rewritten: My card expires next month, do I need to apply for a new one?
details.hyde: No. A replacement card will be sent automatically before expiry—no new application required. Activate it via OTP and set your PIN. Your PayNow, FAST, GIRO and multi-currency account services are unaffected.

details.question: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.rewritten: 可以给我太太办一张 supplementary card 吗？
details.hyde: 可以。主卡人可为我行信用卡申请附属卡给太太，需提交双方身份证明及关系证明，审批后寄卡；收到后激活并设置PIN，交易可享OTP通知。

details.question: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.rewritten: Is your debit card Visa or Mastercard?
details.hyde: We issue both Visa and Mastercard debit cards, depending on your card/account. They support PIN/OTP security and overseas card payments. Check your card face or app for the network.
top_reranked: 外币兑换与外币刷卡费用

details.question: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.rewritten: Can I open an account if I'm 15?
details.hyde: Yes, if you’re 15 you may open an eligible youth/savings account with a parent or guardian’s consent. Bring your ID and guardian’s ID. Access to PayNow, FAST, GIRO, multi-currency accounts, cards and overseas remittance depends on the product and may be restricted. Keep your PIN and OTP secure.

details.question: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.rewritten: 开户需要什么证件？没有 Singpass 可以吗？
details.hyde: 开户请带护照/身份证、有效准证及地址证明；无Singpass可到分行核验办理，并设置PIN/OTP。可开通PayNow、FAST、GIRO及多币种服务。

details.question: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.rewritten: The app keeps rejecting my selfie during verification
details.hyde: Please retake your selfie in a well-lit area without filters, remove glasses/hats/masks, keep your full face within the frame, and follow the on-screen prompts. If it still fails, contact us via in-app support for further verification.

details.question: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.rewritten: 我搬家了，地址要怎么改？
details.hyde: 请登录网上银行/手机银行“个人资料”更新住址，OTP验证；或携身份证明到分行办理。海外电汇、多币种账户及GIRO/PayNow/FAST登记资料请一并核对。

details.question: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.rewritten: I can't remember my internet banking password
details.hyde: Click **“Forgot Password”** on the Internet Banking login page, verify via **OTP** sent to your registered mobile, and reset your password. If you cannot receive the OTP, contact Customer Service.
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁

details.question: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.rewritten: 我想 close 我的 savings account
details.hyde: 请通过网上银行或分行办理销户。先转出余额，取消GIRO、PayNow/FAST关联，结清多币种账户及费用；销户后PIN/OTP失效。

details.question: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: Can I hold Japanese yen in my account?
details.hyde: Yes—JPY can be held in a multi-currency account, subject to your account type. It supports FX conversion and overseas remittances; PayNow, FAST and GIRO are for SGD only.
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 你们可以存比特币吗？
expected: 多币种账户支持的货币
details.rewritten: 你们可以存比特币吗？
details.hyde: 目前本行不支持比特币等加密货币存款或交易。您可使用多币种账户处理合规资金，并通过FAST、PayNow、GIRO或海外电汇入账。
kept: 多币种账户支持的货币
top_reranked: 多币种账户支持的货币

details.question: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.rewritten: 定期存款利率是多少？
details.hyde: 定期存款利率按存期、币种及金额而定，多币种账户各币种利率不同。请登录网上银行/手机银行查看最新利率，实际以办理时公布为准。
top_reranked: 银行卡年费与其他卡费

details.question: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.rewritten: How do I apply for a home loan?
details.hyde: You can apply online via Internet Banking or the mobile app. Prepare your NRIC/passport, income documents and property details, submit the application and verify with an OTP. Alternatively, visit any branch or book an appointment. Our home loan specialist will contact you.

details.question: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.rewritten: 你们的分行几点开门？
details.hyde: 分行通常周一至周五上午9:00开门，周六时间因分行而异，周日及公共假期休息。PayNow、FAST、海外电汇等可经网上/手机银行全天候办理，请以分行公告为准。

details.question: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.rewritten: Does my credit card come with travel insurance?
details.hyde: Your credit card may include travel insurance if it is an eligible card. Coverage, limits and eligibility vary by card type; please check the Terms & Conditions or Card Benefits in the app.

details.question: 那 FAST 呢？
details.rewritten: FAST 转账的手续费是多少？
details.hyde: 通过网上银行/手机银行办理FAST转账一般免手续费；柜台或特殊渠道可能收费，具体以本行最新收费表为准。

details.question: what if I forgot the PIN?
expected: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
details.rewritten: What if I forgot the PIN for my new card?
details.hyde: Please reset your card PIN via Online Banking/Mobile Banking or at any ATM. You’ll need your card and an OTP. If you need help, call our hotline.
kept: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
top_reranked: 修改 PIN 与 PIN 被锁
